class.name: TamaBulletRegistry
class.brief_description: A Resource that maps bullet and laser type names to their configs and scenes.
class.description:
[b]TamaBulletRegistry[/b] holds the full set of object types known to Tama. It can be configured imperatively via [TamaManager] methods, or assembled as a [Resource] asset and assigned to [method TamaManager.set_registry].
[b]objects[/b] is the primary map. It associates type name strings with [TamaServerObjectConfig] subclass instances: - [TamaServerBulletConfig] — high-performance server bullets rendered with MultiMesh. - [TamaServerStraightLaserConfig] — straight beam lasers with a four-phase lifetime. - [TamaServerCurvedLaserConfig] — ribbon-trail lasers whose head moves each frame.
[b]scene_bullets[/b] maps type names to [PackedScene] resources for scene-based bullets (full scene graph, one node per bullet).
When a TamaScript [code]bul[/code] block references a type name, Tama checks [member objects] first, then [member scene_bullets]. If the type is not found, the fallback depends on [member default_to_server_bullets]: [code]false[/code] uses [member default_scene_bullet]; [code]true[/code] uses [member default_server_bullet].

method.name: get_object_config
method.description: Returns the [TamaServerObjectConfig] registered under [param type] in [member objects], or [code]null[/code] if none is found. Use this when you don't know the subtype in advance; cast the result to the appropriate config class if needed.

method.name: get_server_config
method.description: Returns the [TamaServerBulletConfig] registered under [param type], or [code]null[/code] if none is found or the registered config is not a bullet config.

members.member: Maps type name strings to [TamaServerObjectConfig] resources (bullets, straight lasers, or curved lasers). This is the primary registry for all server-side object types.
Maps type name strings to [PackedScene] resources for scene-based bullets.
Fallback scene used when a bullet type is not found and [member default_to_server_bullets] is [code]false[/code].
Fallback server bullet config used when a type is not found and [member default_to_server_bullets] is [code]true[/code].
When [code]true[/code], bullets with an unrecognised type fall back to [member default_server_bullet] instead of [member default_scene_bullet].
